guarantees.claim: prd_o is always the bitwise concatenation of b_yz0_q and bxz0_z1_q

assumptions.claim: b_yz0_q and bxz0_z1_q are statistically independent masked shares of a DOM multiplication result
assumptions.cond: when prd_o is used by downstream non-DOM logic
assumptions.risk: If the shares are correlated or improperly masked, secret information may be exposed through prd_o

uncertain_points.claim: The comment 'Optional Pipelining' indicates that prd_o may or may not be registered before consumption; the actual pipeline depth and its effect on glitch propagation are unknown from this chunk alone
uncertain_points.cond: if optional pipeline is absent or insufficient
uncertain_points.risk: Glitchy transitions on prd_o could lead to first-order leakage or functional misalignment of shares in subsequent DOM stages
